entry.name: command
entry.label: The program the widget runs to reach the daemon: a bare name on PATH (sarvam-meter) or an absolute path. It is executed, so it must contain no spaces, quotes or shell metacharacters.

entry.name: refreshSeconds
entry.label: How often the widget polls the daemon, in seconds

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Which value the compact representation shows: sarvam (Sarvam balance) or cliproxy (CLIProxyAPI quota)

entry.name: warnBelowPercent
entry.label: Show a warning when the remaining balance or quota falls below this percentage

entry.name: showApiBreakdown
entry.label: Show the per-API spend breakdown in the full representation
